# useDataTable options

`useDataTable(options)` accepts everything TanStack's [`TableOptions`](https://tanstack.com/table/latest) accepts (controlled `state`, `on*Change`, `manual*` flags, `getRowId`, `getSubRows`, `initialState`, …; column pinning in `state`/`initialState` keeps the `left`/`right` shape) **plus** the data-table options below. The table below is generated from the source types; defaults come from the hook implementation.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `initialState` | `Omit< NonNullable<CoreTableOptions<TData>["initialState"]>, "columnPinning" \| "pagination" > & { columnPinning?: DataTableColumnPinningState pagination?: Partial<PaginationState> }` |  | Initial values for uncontrolled table state. `pagination` may be partial (TanStack fills the rest from its defaults); column pinning uses `left` / `right`. |
| `state` | `Omit< NonNullable<CoreTableOptions<TData>["state"]>, "columnPinning" > & { columnPinning?: DataTableColumnPinningState }` |  | Controlled table state slices. Column pinning uses `left` / `right` (not TanStack v9's `start` / `end`). |
| `onColumnPinningChange` | `OnChangeFn<DataTableColumnPinningState>` |  | Called with an updater over the `left` / `right` pinning state when the user pins or unpins a column. |
| `stateSelector` | `(state: DataTableState) => unknown` |  | Re-render the component that calls `useDataTable` when the selected part of the table state changes (compared shallowly). By default it does not re-render on table state changes at all: `<DataTable>` subscribes to what it shows. Select what your own render reads, e.g. `(state) => state.rowSelection` for a "3 selected" label. |
| `localization` | `Partial<DataTableLocalization>` |  | Text for every label, message and screen-reader string. Partial: missing keys fall back to English (or to `DataTableConfigProvider`). Install a locale item for a full language. |
| `icons` | `Partial<DataTableIcons>` |  | Override any subset of the table's icons. |
| `isLoading` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the loading affordances (progress bar; skeletons when empty; a dimming overlay over existing rows). Toggle each independently below. |
| `isSaving` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the progress bar for an in-flight save/mutation. Defaults the progress bar on without replacing rows with skeletons. |
| `showProgressBars` | `boolean` |  | Show the top progress bar. Default: `isLoading \|\| isSaving`. |
| `showSkeletons` | `boolean` |  | Show skeleton rows while the body is empty. Default: `isLoading`. Passing `true` also covers rows already shown with skeletons (e.g. while refetching), instead of dimming them. |
| `showLoadingOverlay` | `boolean` |  | Dim existing rows with an overlay while loading. Default: `isLoading`. |
| `enableFacetedValues` | `boolean` | `true` | Compute faceted unique values / min-max (auto select options + range bounds). Default true; disable to skip the faceted row models. |
| `enableColumnActions` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the column-actions menu in each header (sort, filter, pin, hide, group…). Default `true`. |
| `enableColumnFilterModes` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the filter-mode menu adornment on filter fields. Default true. |
| `enableFilterMatchHighlighting` | `boolean` | `true` | Highlight matched substrings in cells. Default true. |
| `enableGlobalFilter` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the expandable global search in the toolbar. Default true. |
| `enableGlobalFilterModes` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the global search mode menu (fuzzy/contains/…). Default true. |
| `filterFns` | `Record<string, DataTableFilterFn<TData>>` | `NO_FILTER_FNS` | Your own filter functions, by name (TanStack's filter function signature). Name one on a column's `filterFn`, as a column's `meta.filterMode`, or in `columnFilterModeOptions` / `globalFilterModeOptions` to offer it in the mode menus (labelled by `localization.filterModes[name]`, else the name). The names are read when the table is created; the functions stay current. |
| `sortFns` | `Record<string, DataTableSortFn<TData>>` |  | Your own sort functions, by name; a column uses one with `sortFn: "name"`. The names are read when the table is created; the functions stay current. |
| `aggregationFns` | `Record<string, DataTableAggregationFn<TData>>` |  | Your own aggregation functions, by name; a column uses one with `aggregationFn: "name"`. The names are read when the table is created; the functions stay current. |
| `columnFilterModeOptions` | `FilterMode[]` |  | Restrict (and order) every column's filter-mode menu to these modes — built-in ones (kept where the column's variant supports them) and custom `filterFns` names. A column's `meta.columnFilterModeOptions` wins. |
| `globalFilterModeOptions` | `GlobalFilterMode[]` | `GLOBAL_FILTER_MODES as GlobalFilterMode[]` | Restrict (and order) the global search mode menu: built-in modes and custom `filterFns` names. |
| `enableGlobalFilterRankedResults` | `boolean` | `false` | While the global search is in fuzzy mode, order rows by best match (most relevant first) until the user applies their own sort. Default false — MRT defaults this on, but the data table keeps it off so searching never silently reorders rows unless opted in. Ignored for non-fuzzy modes, when grouping or expanded, or under manual sorting/filtering. |
| `enableBatchRowSelection` | `boolean` | `true` | Shift-click a row's checkbox to select (or clear) every row since the last one clicked. Default true. |
| `displayColumnDefOptions` | `Partial< Record<DisplayColumnId, Partial<DataTableColumnDef<TData, unknown>>> >` |  | Column options for the columns the table adds itself (selection, expand, row actions, row number, row pin, drag handle), by id — e.g. `{ "cn-select": { size: 48 } }`. `meta` merges with the column's own. |
| `defaultDisplayColumn` | `Partial<DataTableColumnDef<TData, unknown>>` |  | Column options applied to every column the table adds itself, under `displayColumnDefOptions`. |
| `slotProps` | `DataTableSlots<TData>` |  | Props for the table's parts (cells, rows, toolbars, …), as an object or a function of the part's context. `className` is combined with the table's, `style` merged, event handlers both run; other props replace the table's. See `DataTableSlots`. |
| `pageSizeOptions` | `number[]` | `DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS` | Choices in the rows-per-page select. Default `[5, 10, 25, 50, 100]`. |
| `onDensityChange` | `(density: Density) => void` |  | Called whenever the density changes (toolbar toggle or programmatic). Set it with `initialState.density`, control it with `state.density`. |
| `onIsFullscreenChange` | `(isFullscreen: boolean) => void` |  | Called whenever the full-screen state is toggled. Control it with `state.isFullscreen`. |
| `onShowColumnFiltersChange` | `(showColumnFilters: boolean) => void` |  | Called whenever the filter row is shown or hidden. Set it with `initialState.showColumnFilters`, control it with `state.showColumnFilters`. |
| `onShowGlobalFilterChange` | `(showGlobalFilter: boolean) => void` |  | Called whenever the global search box opens or closes. Set it with `initialState.showGlobalFilter`, control it with `state.showGlobalFilter`. |
| `enableAdvancedFilter` | `boolean` | `false` | Enable the advanced filter panel: compound rules joined by AND/OR, applied on top of the per-column filters. A toolbar button opens the panel and shows the active-rule count. Default false. |
| `onAdvancedFilterChange` | `(filter: AdvancedFilterGroup) => void` |  | Called whenever the advanced filter changes. Set it with `initialState.advancedFilter`, control it with `state.advancedFilter`. |
| `onGlobalFilterModeChange` | `(mode: GlobalFilterMode) => void` |  | Called whenever the global search mode changes (default `"fuzzy"`). Set it with `initialState.globalFilterMode`, control it with `state.globalFilterMode`. |
| `onColumnFilterModesChange` | `(modes: Record<string, FilterMode>) => void` |  | Called when a column's filter mode changes, with every column's mode. Control it with `state.columnFilterModes`. |
| `onShowAdvancedFilterPanelChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called when the advanced filter dialog opens or closes. Control it with `state.showAdvancedFilterPanel`. |
| `onEditingCellChange` | `(cell: EditingCell \| null) => void` |  | Called when cell editing starts or ends (`null`). Control it with `state.editingCell`. |
| `onEditingRowIdChange` | `(rowId: string \| null) => void` |  | Called when row editing starts or ends (`null`). Control it with `state.editingRowId`. |
| `onIsCreatingChange` | `(isCreating: boolean) => void` |  | Called when the new-row editor opens or closes. Control it with `state.isCreating`. |
| `onRowDraftChange` | `(draft: Record<string, unknown>) => void` |  | Called when the draft of the row being edited or created changes. Control it with `state.rowDraft`. |
| `enableColumnOrdering` | `boolean` | `false` | Drag-and-drop column reordering (adds a grip to each header). |
| `enableColumnPinning` | `boolean` | `false` | Column pinning (left/right) via the column-actions menu + sticky columns. |
| `enableColumnResizing` | `boolean` | `false` | Column resizing via an edge drag handle. |
| `enableColumnAutosize` | `boolean` |  | Double-clicking a column's resize handle auto-sizes it to fit its widest value. Defaults to `enableColumnResizing`. When off, double-click resets the column to its default size instead. |
| `enableRowOrdering` | `boolean` | `false` | Drag-and-drop row reordering (adds a drag-handle column). |
| `enableRowPinning` | `boolean` | `false` | Row pinning (top) via a pin toggle in the row-number column. |
| `enableRowNumbers` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds a leading row-number column. |
| `rowNumberMode` | `"static" \| "original"` | `"static"` | "static" tracks the current view (page-aware); "original" uses source index. |
| `enableRowDragging` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds a drag handle to each row for moving rows out of the table — to another table or a drop zone in the same `DataTableDndProvider` — without reordering inside it (combine with `enableRowOrdering` for both). Default false. |
| `onRowDragEnd` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> over: RowDropTarget }) => void` |  | Called when a row is dropped on another table or a drop zone in the same `DataTableDndProvider`. Move the row in your data. |
| `onRowOrderChange` | `(activeRowId: string, overRowId: string) => void` |  | Called on a row drag-and-drop reorder; the consumer reorders its data. |
| `enableGrouping` | `boolean` | `false` | Row grouping (group-by menu + drop-to-group zone + aggregated group rows). |
| `enableExpanding` | `boolean` |  | Row expansion (tree sub-rows and/or detail panels). Auto-on with grouping or when `renderDetailPanel`/`getSubRows` is provided. |
| `enableStickyFooter` | `boolean` | `false` | Pin the footer (aggregation/footer cells) to the bottom of the surface. Default false. |
| `rowPinningDisplayMode` | `RowPinningDisplayMode` | `"top-and-bottom"` | Where pinned rows show and how rows get pinned (see {@link RowPinningDisplayMode}). Default `"top-and-bottom"`. |
| `enableTableHead` | `boolean` | `true` | Render the header rows. Default true; `false` shows the body only. |
| `enableTableFooter` | `boolean` | `true` | Render the footer rows when columns define a `footer`. Default true. |
| `enableExpandAll` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the expand-all toggle in the expand column's header. Default true. |
| `renderDetailPanel` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Render an expanding detail panel for each row. |
| `enableEditing` | `boolean \| ((row: DataTableRow<TData>) => boolean)` | `false` | Enable inline editing, or decide per row with a function (rows it returns false for can't be edited; creating rows is still allowed). |
| `editDisplayMode` | `EditDisplayMode` | `"cell"` | How edits are surfaced. Default "cell". |
| `createDisplayMode` | `CreateDisplayMode` | `"modal"` | How the create form is surfaced, independent of `editDisplayMode`: `"modal"` (dialog, default), `"row"` (an inline editable row at the top of the table), or `"custom"` (you render it from `isCreating` + `rowDraft`). |
| `createRowDefaults` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Default values for the create form, keyed by column id. |
| `enableClickToCopy` | `ClickToCopyOption<TData>` | `false` | Copy cells on click (`true`), from the cell menu (`"context-menu"`), or decide per cell with a function. Per-column override via meta. |
| `enableCellActions` | `boolean \| ((cell: DataTableCell<TData, unknown>) => boolean)` | `false` | A right-click menu on each cell with built-in Copy (when click-to-copy is on) and Edit (when the cell is editable) items, or a function deciding per cell. `renderCellActionMenuItems` customizes it. Default false. |
| `onEditingCellSave` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> column: DataTableColumn<TData, unknown> value: unknown table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => void` |  | Called when a cell edit is committed (cell and table editing) with the new `value`. Persist it; the table does not change `data` itself. |
| `onEditingRowSave` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> values: Record<string, unknown> table: DataTableInstance<TData> exit: () => void }) => void` |  | Called when a row edit is saved (row and modal editing) with the edited `values`. Call `exit()` to leave editing, e.g. after the save succeeds. |
| `onCreatingRowSave` | `(props: { values: Record<string, unknown> table: DataTableInstance<TData> exit: () => void }) => void` |  | Called when the new-row editor is saved with the row's `values`. Call `exit()` to close it. |
| `onEditingRowCancel` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => void` |  | Called when the user cancels a row edit (Cancel, closing the dialog). |
| `onCreatingRowCancel` | `(props: { table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => void` |  | Called when the user cancels the create form. |
| `renderEditRowDialogContent` | `( props: EditDialogContentProps<TData> & { row: DataTableRow<TData> } ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the edit dialog's content. You get the built-in fields as `internalEditComponents`, plus `save()` / `cancel()`. |
| `renderCreateRowDialogContent` | `( props: EditDialogContentProps<TData> ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the create dialog's content (same props, without `row`). |
| `positionCreatingRow` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| number` | `"top"` | Where the inline create row (`createDisplayMode: "row"`) appears: `"top"` (default), `"bottom"`, or a row index on the current page to insert it before (with row virtualization an index means `"top"`). |
| `renderRowActions` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Content of the row-actions column, replacing the default edit and menu buttons. |
| `renderCellActionMenuItems` | `(props: { cell: DataTableCell<TData, unknown> row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> /** The built-in items (Copy, Edit) the menu shows for this cell. */ internalMenuItems: React.ReactNode closeMenu: () => void }) => React.ReactNode` |  | The contents of the right-click menu on each cell (turns the menu on). Include `internalMenuItems` to keep the built-in Copy / Edit items. |
| `renderRowActionMenuItems` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> /** The built-in items (Edit, when the row can be edited). */ internalMenuItems: React.ReactNode closeMenu: () => void }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Render a kebab menu in the row-actions column. Returns the menu items (e.g. `<DropdownMenuItem>`); injects the actions column automatically. While editing is on, the Edit action moves into this menu: include `internalMenuItems` to keep it. |
| `renderColumnActionsMenuItems` | `(props: { column: DataTableColumn<TData, unknown> table: DataTableInstance<TData> /** The built-in items (sort, filter, hide, group, pin). */ internalMenuItems: React.ReactNode closeMenu: () => void }) => React.ReactNode` |  | The contents of every column-actions menu. Return your items (e.g. `<DropdownMenuItem>`) with `internalMenuItems` where the built-in ones should go, or leave it out to replace them. |
| `renderColumnFilterModeMenuItems` | `(props: { column: DataTableColumn<TData, unknown> modes: FilterMode[] currentMode: FilterMode onSelect: (mode: FilterMode) => void table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the radio items in a column's filter-mode menu. Render your own items and call `onSelect(mode)` to switch; `modes` is the allowed set. |
| `renderGlobalFilterModeMenuItems` | `(props: { modes: GlobalFilterMode[] currentMode: GlobalFilterMode onSelect: (mode: GlobalFilterMode) => void table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the radio items in the global-search mode menu. Render your own items and call `onSelect(mode)` to switch; `modes` is the allowed set. |
| `onRowClick` | `(props: RowEvent<TData>) => void` |  | Fired when a body row is clicked / double-clicked. |
| `onRowDoubleClick` | `(props: RowEvent<TData>) => void` |  | Called when a row is double-clicked. Double-clicks on controls inside the row (edit, expand, pin…) are ignored. |
| `onCellClick` | `(props: CellEvent<TData>) => void` |  | Fired when a body cell is clicked / double-clicked. |
| `onCellDoubleClick` | `(props: CellEvent<TData>) => void` |  | Called when a cell is double-clicked. Double-clicks on controls inside the cell are ignored. |
| `enableRowVirtualization` | `boolean` | `false` | Virtualize body rows for large datasets (recommended past ~100 rows). The table surface becomes the scroll container — give it a bounded height via `className`/`style` (defaults to `max-h-[600px]`). Disables row DnD. |
| `enableColumnVirtualization` | `boolean` | `false` | Virtualize columns for very wide tables. Applies fixed column widths; works with column pinning (pinned columns stay rendered), column ordering and grouped headers. |
| `estimateRowHeight` | `number` | `52` | Estimated row height (px) for the virtualizer. Default 52. |
| `virtualOverscan` | `number` | `8` | Extra rows rendered above/below the viewport. Default 8. |
| `rowHeight` | `number` |  | Flat height (px) applied to every row. Overridden per-row by `getRowHeight`. Also seeds the virtualizer estimate. |
| `getRowHeight` | `(row: DataTableRow<TData>) => number \| "auto" \| null` |  | Per-row height. Return a px number to pin the row, `"auto"` to let it wrap and grow to fit its content (even with column resizing on), or `null` to fall back to `rowHeight` / the density default. Applies to data rows. |
| `rowVirtualizerOptions` | `RowVirtualizerOptions<TData>` |  | Partial `@tanstack/react-virtual` options merged into the row virtualizer (overrides the built-in `count`/`estimateSize`/`overscan`/`measureElement`). Accepts an object or a `({ table }) => options` function. |
| `columnVirtualizerOptions` | `ColumnVirtualizerOptions<TData>` |  | Partial `@tanstack/react-virtual` options merged into the column virtualizer. Accepts an object or a `({ table }) => options` function. |
| `rowVirtualizerInstanceRef` | `React.RefObject<DataTableRowVirtualizer \| null>` |  | Ref populated with the row `Virtualizer` instance for imperative control (e.g. `scrollToIndex`). Only set when `enableRowVirtualization`. |
| `columnVirtualizerInstanceRef` | `React.RefObject<DataTableColumnVirtualizer \| null>` |  | Ref populated with the column `Virtualizer` instance. Only set when `enableColumnVirtualization`. |
| `enableStickyHeader` | `boolean` | `true` | Pin the header rows to the top of the scrollable surface. Also gives the surface a default viewport-bound max-height (`clamp(350px, 100dvh - 200px, 9999px)`) so tall content scrolls internally; override the bound with `slotProps.surface`. Default true. |
| `enablePagination` | `boolean` | `true` | Splits rows into pages with pagination controls. Default `true`; turn it off for virtualization or infinite scroll. |
| `enableInfiniteScroll` | `boolean` | `false` | Load more rows as the user scrolls near the bottom (infinite append). When on, the pager is hidden and pagination is forced to a single growing page, so all appended rows render. Fully controlled: the table calls `onLoadMore` only when the bottom sentinel nears the viewport AND `hasNextPage` AND `!isFetchingNextPage`. Pairs directly with TanStack Query's `useInfiniteQuery` (`fetchNextPage`/`hasNextPage`/`isFetchingNextPage`). Default false. |
| `onLoadMore` | `() => void` |  | Called to request the next chunk. Should be stable (memoized) so the table doesn't re-trigger on every render. Append the result to `data`. |
| `hasNextPage` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether more rows remain to be loaded. Default false. |
| `isFetchingNextPage` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether a load is currently in flight (blocks re-triggering). Default false. |
| `infiniteScrollThreshold` | `number` | `200` | Distance in px from the bottom at which to prefetch. Default 200. |
| `positionPagination` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "both" \| "none"` | `"bottom"` | Where the pagination controls render. Default "bottom". "none" keeps pagination active but hides the controls. |
| `paginationDisplayMode` | `PaginationDisplayMode` | `"default"` | Pagination control style: `"default"` (range label + first/prev/next/last buttons), `"pages"` (numbered page buttons), or `"custom"` (render your own via `renderBottomToolbarCustomActions`). Default "default". |
| `columnFilterDisplayMode` | `ColumnFilterDisplayMode` | `"subheader"` | Where column filter inputs live: `"subheader"` (a filter row under the header, default), `"popover"` (per-column popovers opened from the column header), or `"custom"` (you render them). |
| `positionGlobalFilter` | `"left" \| "right" \| "none"` | `"right"` | Which toolbar region the global search renders in. Default "right" (the internal-actions cluster). "left" places it next to the title/actions; "none" hides it (same as `enableGlobalFilter: false`). |
| `positionToolbarAlertBanner` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "none"` | `"top"` | Where the row-selection alert banner renders. Default "top". |
| `positionToolbarDropZone` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "both" \| "none"` | `"top"` | Where the group-by drop zone renders (grouping only). Default "top". |
| `positionActionsColumn` | `"first" \| "last"` | `"last"` | Position of the auto-injected row-actions column. Default "last". |
| `positionExpandColumn` | `"first" \| "last"` | `"first"` | Position of the auto-injected expand column (tree / detail panel). Default "first". |
| `selectAllMode` | `"page" \| "all"` | `"page"` | Select-all scope for the header checkbox: the current page ("page", default) or every row ("all"). |
| `enableSelectAll` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the select-all checkbox in the selection column header. Default true. |
| `enableTopToolbar` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the toolbar above the table (title, search, filters, view options). Default `true`. |
| `enableBottomToolbar` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the toolbar below the table (pagination, custom actions). Default `true`. |
| `enableDensityToggle` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the density toggle in the toolbar. Default true. |
| `enableFullscreenToggle` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the full-screen toggle in the toolbar. Default true. |
| `enableToolbarInternalActions` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the toolbar's internal icon-action cluster (search, filters, column visibility, export, density, full screen). Default true. Hides the whole cluster at once; use the per-item flags for finer control. |
| `enableKeyboardNavigation` | `boolean` | `true` | Cell keyboard navigation with a single Tab stop: arrow keys, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Enter or F2 to activate a cell, Ctrl+C to copy it. Also makes the table an ARIA grid. Default `true`. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Heading shown at the start of the top toolbar. |
| `renderTopToolbarCustomActions` | `( props: DataTableSlotProps<TData> ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Custom content rendered in the top toolbar's left region (next to the title), e.g. bulk-action buttons. |
| `renderTopToolbar` | `(props: DataTableSlotProps<TData>) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the entire top toolbar with custom content. |
| `renderBottomToolbar` | `(props: DataTableSlotProps<TData>) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the entire bottom toolbar (pagination region) with custom content. |
| `renderToolbarInternalActions` | `( props: DataTableSlotProps<TData> ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the top toolbar's internal icon-action cluster with custom content. |
| `renderBottomToolbarCustomActions` | `( props: DataTableSlotProps<TData> ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Custom content rendered in the bottom toolbar's left region (next to pagination), e.g. summary text or actions. |
| `renderCaption` | `(props: DataTableSlotProps<TData>) => React.ReactNode` |  | Render a `<caption>` for the table (e.g. an accessible summary). |
| `renderEmpty` | `(props: DataTableSlotProps<TData>) => React.ReactNode` |  | Content shown when there are no rows. Defaults to `localization.noRecordsToDisplay`. |

> **Pass-through options:** Options not listed here (e.g. `data`, `columns`, `state`, `manualPagination`, `rowCount`, `enableRowSelection`, `enableMultiSort`) are standard TanStack Table options and behave exactly as documented there.

---

<!-- https://monabbir-ahmmad.github.io/shadcn-react-table/docs/api/column-options/ -->

# Column options

Per-column configuration lives on the standard TanStack `columnDef.meta` object, which the table augments with the fields below (fully typed wherever `meta` is read).

```tsx
const columns: DataTableColumnDef<Person>[] = [
  {
    accessorKey: "role",
    header: "Role",
    meta: {
      filterVariant: "select",
      filterSelectOptions: ROLE_OPTIONS,
      editVariant: "select",
    },
  },
]
```

| meta key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filterVariant` | `FilterVariant` |  | Filter UI variant rendered in the filter row. Defaults to "text". |
| `filterSelectOptions` | `DataTableFilterOption[]` |  | Options for `select` / `multi-select` filter variants. If omitted for a select-style variant, options are derived from faceted unique values. |
| `filterMode` | `FilterMode` |  | Default filter mode for this column (overrides the per-variant default). |
| `enableColumnFilterModes` | `boolean` |  | Per-column override for the filter-mode menu (defaults to the table). |
| `renderColumnFilter` | `(props: { column: Column<TFeatures, TData, TValue> table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Custom filter UI for this column (escape hatch). Replaces the variant. |
| `columnFilterModeOptions` | `FilterMode[]` |  | Restrict (and order) the filter-mode menu for this column to this subset of modes (built-in ones and custom `filterFns` names). Include the column's default mode. |
| `enableEditing` | `boolean \| ((row: DataTableRow<TData>) => boolean)` |  | Allow editing this column (defaults to true when table editing is on), or decide per row with a function. |
| `editVariant` | `EditVariant` |  | Inline editor variant. Defaults to "text". |
| `editSelectOptions` | `\| DataTableFilterOption[] \| ((props: { row?: DataTableRow<TData> column: DataTableColumn<TData, unknown> table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => DataTableFilterOption[])` |  | Options for the "select" edit variant, or a function returning them for the row being edited (`row` is undefined in the create form). |
| `renderEditCell` | `(props: CellRenderProps<TData, TValue>) => React.ReactNode` |  | Custom inline editor for this column (escape hatch). Replaces the built-in editor while the cell/row is editing; read the draft from `table.getState().rowDraft` and write it with `table.setRowDraftValue` (row editing), or save with `onEditingCellSave` (cell editing). |
| `renderGroupedCell` | `( props: CellRenderProps<TData, TValue> ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Custom render for this column's group header cell (when grouped). |
| `renderAggregatedCell` | `( props: CellRenderProps<TData, TValue> ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Custom render for this column's aggregated cell (when grouped). Overrides the TanStack `columnDef.aggregatedCell`. |
| `renderPlaceholderCell` | `( props: CellRenderProps<TData, TValue> ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Custom render for this column's placeholder cells in grouped rows (cells with no value because another column owns the group). Default: empty. |
| `validate` | `(value: unknown) => string \| undefined` |  | Validate an edited value; return an error message or undefined if valid. |
| `enableClickToCopy` | `ClickToCopyOption<TData>` |  | Copy this column's cells on click (`true`), from the cell menu (`"context-menu"`), or decide per cell with a function. |
| `align` | `"left" \| "center" \| "right"` |  | Horizontal alignment applied to the header label and body cells. |
| `enableFilterMatchHighlighting` | `boolean` |  | `false` opts this column out of match highlighting (the table option of the same name turns it on or off for every column). |
| `visibleInShowHideMenu` | `boolean` |  | `false` leaves this column out of the show / hide columns menu. |
| `enableColumnActions` | `boolean` |  | `false` hides the column-actions menu for this column. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Human-readable label for menus when the header is not a plain string. |
| `slotProps` | `Pick< DataTableSlots<TData>, "headCell" \| "filterCell" \| "bodyCell" \| "footerCell" \| "editField" >` |  | Props for this column's cells, applied after the table's `slotProps` for the same part. |

> **Standard column options still apply:** `accessorKey`, `header`, `cell`, `footer`, `size`, `enableSorting`,
>   `enableColumnFilter`, `aggregationFn`, `aggregatedCell`, `sortDescFirst`, and
>   the rest are standard TanStack [column
>   defs](https://tanstack.com/table/latest).

---

<!-- https://monabbir-ahmmad.github.io/shadcn-react-table/docs/api/data-table-props/ -->

# DataTable props

`<DataTable />` is mostly driven by the instance from `useDataTable`. It accepts the presentational props below, and spreads any other `div` props onto the root element.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `table` | `DataTableInstance<TData>` |  | The instance returned by `useDataTable`. |

```tsx
<DataTable table={table} className="mx-auto max-w-5xl" />
```

> **Styling inner parts:** To reach the scroll surface, rows, cells or any other part, use the [`slotProps`](/docs/guides/slot-props) option on `useDataTable` — for example `slotProps: { surface: { className: "max-h-[600px]" } }` bounds the scroll surface for a [sticky header](/docs/guides/sticky) or a [virtualized](/docs/guides/virtualization) list.

---

<!-- https://monabbir-ahmmad.github.io/shadcn-react-table/docs/api/table-instance/ -->

# Table instance

`useDataTable` returns the standard TanStack table instance with three additions: the table's UI state in `table.getState()` (density, editing, filter modes…), methods to change it on `table` itself, and the resolved options and DOM refs on **`table.dataTable`**.

```tsx
table.beginCreate() // open the create-row form
table.setDensity("compact")
const density = table.getState().density
const isLoading = table.dataTable.isLoading
table.dataTable.refs.searchInputRef.current?.focus()
```

## Methods

| Method | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `setDensity` | `React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Density>>` |  | Updates `density`. |
| `setIsFullscreen` | `React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>` |  | Updates `isFullscreen`. |
| `setShowColumnFilters` | `React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>` |  | Updates `showColumnFilters`. |
| `setShowGlobalFilter` | `React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>` |  | Open or close the global search box. |
| `setColumnFilterMode` | `(columnId: string, mode: FilterMode) => void` |  | Switch a column's filter mode (resets the value when it becomes invalid). |
| `setGlobalFilterMode` | `(mode: GlobalFilterMode) => void` |  | Updates `globalFilterMode`. |
| `setAdvancedFilter` | `React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<AdvancedFilterGroup>>` |  | Updates `advancedFilter`. |
| `setShowAdvancedFilterPanel` | `React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>` |  | Updates `showAdvancedFilterPanel`. |
| `autoSizeColumn` | `(columnId: string) => void` |  | Resize a single column to fit its widest visible value (header + data). |
| `autoSizeAllColumns` | `() => void` |  | Auto-size every resizable visible column. |
| `setEditingCell` | `React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<EditingCell \| null>>` |  | Updates `editingCell`. |
| `setRowDraftValue` | `(columnId: string, value: unknown) => void` |  | Updates `rowDraftValue`. |
| `beginRowEdit` | `(row: DataTableRow<TData>) => void` |  | Enter row/modal editing for a row, seeding the draft from its values. |
| `beginCreate` | `() => void` |  | Open the create form, seeding the draft from `createRowDefaults`. |
| `cancelEdit` | `() => void` |  | Exit any editing/creating state, discarding the draft. |

## `table.dataTable`

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `localization` | `DataTableLocalization` |  | Text for every label, message and screen-reader string. Partial: missing keys fall back to English (or to `DataTableConfigProvider`). Install a locale item for a full language. |
| `icons` | `DataTableIcons` |  | Override any subset of the table's icons. |
| `filterFns` | `Record<string, DataTableFilterFn<TData>>` |  | The consumer's own filter functions, by name. |
| `columnFilterModeOptions` | `FilterMode[] \| undefined` |  | Table-wide filter-mode menu modes, if restricted. |
| `globalFilterModeOptions` | `GlobalFilterMode[]` |  | The global search mode menu's modes. |
| `enableGlobalFilter` | `boolean` |  | Show the expandable global search in the toolbar. Default true. |
| `enableGlobalFilterModes` | `boolean` |  | Show the global search mode menu (fuzzy/contains/…). Default true. |
| `enableAdvancedFilter` | `boolean` |  | Compound AND/OR filter panel (independent of, and additive to, the per-column filters and global search). |
| `isLoading` | `boolean` |  | Show the loading affordances (progress bar; skeletons when empty; a dimming overlay over existing rows). Toggle each independently below. |
| `isSaving` | `boolean` |  | Show the progress bar for an in-flight save/mutation. Defaults the progress bar on without replacing rows with skeletons. |
| `showProgressBars` | `boolean` |  | Show the top progress bar. Default: `isLoading \|\| isSaving`. |
| `showSkeletons` | `boolean` |  | Show skeleton rows while the body is empty. Default: `isLoading`. Passing `true` also covers rows already shown with skeletons (e.g. while refetching), instead of dimming them. |
| `showSkeletonsOverRows` | `boolean` |  | Whether skeletons also cover rows already shown (`showSkeletons: true` was passed explicitly). |
| `showLoadingOverlay` | `boolean` |  | Dim existing rows with an overlay while loading. Default: `isLoading`. |
| `enableFacetedValues` | `boolean` |  | Compute faceted unique values / min-max (auto select options + range bounds). Default true; disable to skip the faceted row models. |
| `enableColumnActions` | `boolean` |  | Shows the column-actions menu in each header (sort, filter, pin, hide, group…). Default `true`. |
| `enableColumnFilters` | `boolean` |  | Whether per-column filters are on. |
| `enableColumnFilterModes` | `boolean` |  | Show the filter-mode menu adornment on filter fields. Default true. |
| `enableFilterMatchHighlighting` | `boolean` |  | Highlight matched substrings in cells. Default true. |
| `enableColumnOrdering` | `boolean` |  | Drag-and-drop column reordering (adds a grip to each header). |
| `enableColumnPinning` | `boolean` |  | Column pinning (left/right) via the column-actions menu + sticky columns. |
| `enableColumnResizing` | `boolean` |  | Column resizing via an edge drag handle. |
| `enableColumnAutosize` | `boolean` |  | Double-clicking a column's resize handle auto-sizes it to fit its widest value. Defaults to `enableColumnResizing`. When off, double-click resets the column to its default size instead. |
| `enableRowOrdering` | `boolean` |  | Drag-and-drop row reordering (adds a drag-handle column). |
| `enableRowPinning` | `boolean` |  | Row pinning (top) via a pin toggle in the row-number column. |
| `enableRowNumbers` | `boolean` |  | Adds a leading row-number column. |
| `rowNumberMode` | `"static" \| "original"` |  | "static" tracks the current view (page-aware); "original" uses source index. |
| `onRowOrderChange` | `(activeRowId: string, overRowId: string) => void` |  | Called on a row drag-and-drop reorder; the consumer reorders its data. |
| `enableGrouping` | `boolean` |  | Row grouping (group-by menu + drop-to-group zone + aggregated group rows). |
| `enableExpanding` | `boolean` |  | Row expansion (tree sub-rows and/or detail panels). Auto-on with grouping or when `renderDetailPanel`/`getSubRows` is provided. |
| `enableStickyFooter` | `boolean` |  | Pin the footer (aggregation/footer cells) to the bottom of the surface. Default false. |
| `rowPinningDisplayMode` | `RowPinningDisplayMode` |  | Where pinned rows show and how rows get pinned. |
| `enableRowDragging` | `boolean` |  | Whether rows have a drag handle for moving them out of the table. |
| `onRowDragEnd` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> over: RowDropTarget }) => void` |  | Called when a row is dropped on another table or a drop zone in the same `DataTableDndProvider`. Move the row in your data. |
| `enableTableHead` | `boolean` |  | Whether the header rows render. |
| `enableTableFooter` | `boolean` |  | Whether the footer rows render (when columns define footers). |
| `enableExpandAll` | `boolean` |  | Whether the expand column's header toggles every row. |
| `renderDetailPanel` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Render an expanding detail panel for each row. |
| `enableEditing` | `boolean` |  | Whether editing is on (a per-row `enableEditing` function counts). |
| `displayColumnDefOptions` | `\| Partial< Record<DisplayColumnId, Partial<DataTableColumnDef<TData, unknown>>> > \| undefined` |  | Overrides for the columns the table adds itself, by id. A new object re-renders the rows, so memoize it when you pass functions. |
| `defaultDisplayColumn` | `Partial<DataTableColumnDef<TData, unknown>> \| undefined` |  | Overrides for every column the table adds itself. |
| `getCanEditRow` | `(row: DataTableRow<TData>) => boolean` |  | Whether a row can be edited: the `enableEditing` function's answer, or `enableEditing` itself. |
| `editDisplayMode` | `EditDisplayMode` |  | How edits are surfaced. Default "cell". |
| `createDisplayMode` | `CreateDisplayMode` |  | How the create form is surfaced, independent of `editDisplayMode`: `"modal"` (dialog, default), `"row"` (an inline editable row at the top of the table), or `"custom"` (you render it from `isCreating` + `rowDraft`). |
| `cancelEditing` | `() => void` |  | Cancel as the user does: calls `onEditingRowCancel` / `onCreatingRowCancel`, then `cancelEdit`. |
| `onEditingRowCancel` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => void` |  | Called when the user cancels a row edit (Cancel, closing the dialog). |
| `onCreatingRowCancel` | `(props: { table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => void` |  | Called when the user cancels the create form. |
| `renderEditRowDialogContent` | `( props: EditDialogContentProps<TData> & { row: DataTableRow<TData> } ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the edit dialog's content. You get the built-in fields as `internalEditComponents`, plus `save()` / `cancel()`. |
| `renderCreateRowDialogContent` | `( props: EditDialogContentProps<TData> ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the create dialog's content (same props, without `row`). |
| `positionCreatingRow` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| number` |  | Where the inline create row (`createDisplayMode: "row"`) appears: `"top"` (default), `"bottom"`, or a row index on the current page to insert it before (with row virtualization an index means `"top"`). |
| `enableClickToCopy` | `ClickToCopyOption<TData>` |  | Copy cells on click (`true`), from the cell menu (`"context-menu"`), or decide per cell with a function. Per-column override via meta. |
| `enableCellActions` | `boolean \| ((cell: DataTableCell<TData, unknown>) => boolean)` |  | A right-click menu on each cell with built-in Copy (when click-to-copy is on) and Edit (when the cell is editable) items, or a function deciding per cell. `renderCellActionMenuItems` customizes it. Default false. |
| `onEditingCellSave` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> column: DataTableColumn<TData, unknown> value: unknown table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => void` |  | Called when a cell edit is committed (cell and table editing) with the new `value`. Persist it; the table does not change `data` itself. |
| `onEditingRowSave` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> values: Record<string, unknown> table: DataTableInstance<TData> exit: () => void }) => void` |  | Called when a row edit is saved (row and modal editing) with the edited `values`. Call `exit()` to leave editing, e.g. after the save succeeds. |
| `onCreatingRowSave` | `(props: { values: Record<string, unknown> table: DataTableInstance<TData> exit: () => void }) => void` |  | Called when the new-row editor is saved with the row's `values`. Call `exit()` to close it. |
| `renderRowActions` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Content of the row-actions column, replacing the default edit and menu buttons. |
| `renderCellActionMenuItems` | `(props: { cell: DataTableCell<TData, unknown> row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> /** The built-in items (Copy, Edit) the menu shows for this cell. */ internalMenuItems: React.ReactNode closeMenu: () => void }) => React.ReactNode` |  | The contents of the right-click menu on each cell (turns the menu on). Include `internalMenuItems` to keep the built-in Copy / Edit items. |
| `renderRowActionMenuItems` | `(props: { row: DataTableRow<TData> table: DataTableInstance<TData> /** The built-in items (Edit, when the row can be edited). */ internalMenuItems: React.ReactNode closeMenu: () => void }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Render a kebab menu in the row-actions column. Returns the menu items (e.g. `<DropdownMenuItem>`); injects the actions column automatically. While editing is on, the Edit action moves into this menu: include `internalMenuItems` to keep it. |
| `renderColumnActionsMenuItems` | `(props: { column: DataTableColumn<TData, unknown> table: DataTableInstance<TData> /** The built-in items (sort, filter, hide, group, pin). */ internalMenuItems: React.ReactNode closeMenu: () => void }) => React.ReactNode` |  | The contents of every column-actions menu. Return your items (e.g. `<DropdownMenuItem>`) with `internalMenuItems` where the built-in ones should go, or leave it out to replace them. |
| `renderColumnFilterModeMenuItems` | `(props: { column: DataTableColumn<TData, unknown> modes: FilterMode[] currentMode: FilterMode onSelect: (mode: FilterMode) => void table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the radio items in a column's filter-mode menu. Render your own items and call `onSelect(mode)` to switch; `modes` is the allowed set. |
| `renderGlobalFilterModeMenuItems` | `(props: { modes: GlobalFilterMode[] currentMode: GlobalFilterMode onSelect: (mode: GlobalFilterMode) => void table: DataTableInstance<TData> }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the radio items in the global-search mode menu. Render your own items and call `onSelect(mode)` to switch; `modes` is the allowed set. |
| `onRowClick` | `(props: RowEvent<TData>) => void` |  | Fired when a body row is clicked / double-clicked. |
| `onRowDoubleClick` | `(props: RowEvent<TData>) => void` |  | Called when a row is double-clicked. Double-clicks on controls inside the row (edit, expand, pin…) are ignored. |
| `onCellClick` | `(props: CellEvent<TData>) => void` |  | Fired when a body cell is clicked / double-clicked. |
| `onCellDoubleClick` | `(props: CellEvent<TData>) => void` |  | Called when a cell is double-clicked. Double-clicks on controls inside the cell are ignored. |
| `refs` | `DataTableRefs` |  | DOM refs to the table's structural elements (populated after mount). |
| `enableRowVirtualization` | `boolean` |  | Virtualize body rows for large datasets (recommended past ~100 rows). The table surface becomes the scroll container — give it a bounded height via `className`/`style` (defaults to `max-h-[600px]`). Disables row DnD. |
| `enableColumnVirtualization` | `boolean` |  | Virtualize columns for very wide tables. Applies fixed column widths; works with column pinning (pinned columns stay rendered), column ordering and grouped headers. |
| `estimateRowHeight` | `number` |  | Estimated row height (px) for the virtualizer. Default 52. |
| `virtualOverscan` | `number` |  | Extra rows rendered above/below the viewport. Default 8. |
| `rowHeight` | `number` |  | Flat height (px) applied to every row. |
| `getRowHeight` | `(row: DataTableRow<TData>) => number \| "auto" \| null` |  | Per-row height: a px number, `"auto"` (wrap + grow), or `null` for default. |
| `rowVirtualizerOptions` | `RowVirtualizerOptions<TData>` |  | Partial `@tanstack/react-virtual` options merged into the row virtualizer (overrides the built-in `count`/`estimateSize`/`overscan`/`measureElement`). Accepts an object or a `({ table }) => options` function. |
| `columnVirtualizerOptions` | `ColumnVirtualizerOptions<TData>` |  | Partial `@tanstack/react-virtual` options merged into the column virtualizer. Accepts an object or a `({ table }) => options` function. |
| `rowVirtualizerInstanceRef` | `React.RefObject<DataTableRowVirtualizer \| null>` |  | Ref populated with the row `Virtualizer` instance for imperative control (e.g. `scrollToIndex`). Only set when `enableRowVirtualization`. |
| `columnVirtualizerInstanceRef` | `React.RefObject<DataTableColumnVirtualizer \| null>` |  | Ref populated with the column `Virtualizer` instance. Only set when `enableColumnVirtualization`. |
| `enableStickyHeader` | `boolean` |  | Pin the header rows to the top of the scrollable surface. Also gives the surface a default viewport-bound max-height (`clamp(350px, 100dvh - 200px, 9999px)`) so tall content scrolls internally; override the bound with `slotProps.surface`. Default true. |
| `enablePagination` | `boolean` |  | Splits rows into pages with pagination controls. Default `true`; turn it off for virtualization or infinite scroll. |
| `enableInfiniteScroll` | `boolean` |  | Load more rows as the user scrolls near the bottom (auto-hides the pager). |
| `onLoadMore` | `() => void` |  | Called when the sentinel nears the viewport and more rows can be loaded. |
| `hasNextPage` | `boolean` |  | Consumer flag: more rows exist to load. |
| `isFetchingNextPage` | `boolean` |  | Consumer flag: a load is currently in flight. |
| `infiniteScrollThreshold` | `number` |  | Distance (px) from the bottom at which to prefetch. |
| `positionPagination` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "both" \| "none"` |  | Where the pagination controls render. Default "bottom". "none" keeps pagination active but hides the controls. |
| `paginationDisplayMode` | `PaginationDisplayMode` |  | Pagination control style: `"default"` (range label + first/prev/next/last buttons), `"pages"` (numbered page buttons), or `"custom"` (render your own via `renderBottomToolbarCustomActions`). Default "default". |
| `pageSizeOptions` | `number[]` |  | Choices in the rows-per-page select. |
| `slotProps` | `DataTableSlots<TData> \| undefined` |  | Props for the table's parts; see the `slotProps` option. |
| `columnFilterDisplayMode` | `ColumnFilterDisplayMode` |  | Where column filter inputs live: `"subheader"` (a filter row under the header, default), `"popover"` (per-column popovers opened from the column header), or `"custom"` (you render them). |
| `positionGlobalFilter` | `"left" \| "right" \| "none"` |  | Which toolbar region the global search renders in. Default "right" (the internal-actions cluster). "left" places it next to the title/actions; "none" hides it (same as `enableGlobalFilter: false`). |
| `positionToolbarAlertBanner` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "none"` |  | Where the row-selection alert banner renders. Default "top". |
| `positionToolbarDropZone` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "both" \| "none"` |  | Where the group-by drop zone renders (grouping only). Default "top". |
| `enableRowSelection` | `boolean` |  | Whether rows can be selected. |
| `enableBatchRowSelection` | `boolean` |  | Shift-click a row's checkbox to select or clear the range since the last click. |
| `enableTopToolbar` | `boolean` |  | Shows the toolbar above the table (title, search, filters, view options). Default `true`. |
| `enableBottomToolbar` | `boolean` |  | Shows the toolbar below the table (pagination, custom actions). Default `true`. |
| `enableDensityToggle` | `boolean` |  | Show the density toggle in the toolbar. Default true. |
| `enableFullscreenToggle` | `boolean` |  | Show the full-screen toggle in the toolbar. Default true. |
| `enableToolbarInternalActions` | `boolean` |  | Show the toolbar's internal icon-action cluster (search, filters, column visibility, export, density, full screen). Default true. Hides the whole cluster at once; use the per-item flags for finer control. |
| `enableKeyboardNavigation` | `boolean` |  | Cell keyboard navigation with a single Tab stop: arrow keys, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Enter or F2 to activate a cell, Ctrl+C to copy it. Also makes the table an ARIA grid. Default `true`. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Heading shown at the start of the top toolbar. |
| `renderTopToolbarCustomActions` | `( props: DataTableSlotProps<TData> ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Custom content rendered in the top toolbar's left region (next to the title), e.g. bulk-action buttons. |
| `renderTopToolbar` | `(props: DataTableSlotProps<TData>) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the entire top toolbar with custom content. |
| `renderBottomToolbar` | `(props: DataTableSlotProps<TData>) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the entire bottom toolbar (pagination region) with custom content. |
| `renderToolbarInternalActions` | `( props: DataTableSlotProps<TData> ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Replace the top toolbar's internal icon-action cluster with custom content. |
| `renderBottomToolbarCustomActions` | `( props: DataTableSlotProps<TData> ) => React.ReactNode` |  | Custom content rendered in the bottom toolbar's left region (next to pagination), e.g. summary text or actions. |
| `renderCaption` | `(props: DataTableSlotProps<TData>) => React.ReactNode` |  | Render a `<caption>` for the table (e.g. an accessible summary). |
| `renderEmpty` | `(props: DataTableSlotProps<TData>) => React.ReactNode` |  | Content shown when there are no rows. Defaults to `localization.noRecordsToDisplay`. |

> **Everything else is TanStack:** All standard instance methods — `getState`, `getRowModel`, `getColumn`,
>   `setPageIndex`, `getFilteredRowModel`, `resetSorting`, … — are available
>   directly on `table` as usual.

# Localization

Every user-facing string flows through a localization table. Override any subset per instance via `useDataTable({ localization })`, or app-wide via [`DataTableConfigProvider`](/docs/guides/custom-icons). Function-valued entries handle interpolation and plurals.

```tsx
const table = useDataTable({
  data,
  columns,
  localization: {
    search: "Buscar",
    rowsPerPage: "Filas por página",
    paginationRange: (start, end, total) => `${start}–${end} de ${total}`,
  },
})
```

See the [Localization guide](/docs/guides/localization) for a full example. The complete key set and English defaults:

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `language` | `string` | `en` | BCP 47 tag used to format dates (e.g. "en", "de"). Numbers are formatted by the function keys of each localization, with that file's own tag. |
| `selectAll` | `string` | `Select all` |  |
| `selectRow` | `string` | `Select row` |  |
| `clearSelection` | `string` | `Clear selection` |  |
| `rowsSelected` | `(selected: number, total: number) => string` | `(selected, total) => `${selected.toLocaleString("en")} of ${total.toLocaleString("en")} row${total === 1 ? "" : "s"} selected`` |  |
| `sortByColumnAsc` | `(column: string) => string` | `(column) => `Sort by ${column} ascending`` |  |
| `sortByColumnDesc` | `(column: string) => string` | `(column) => `Sort by ${column} descending`` |  |
| `sortAscending` | `string` | `Sort ascending` |  |
| `sortDescending` | `string` | `Sort descending` |  |
| `clearSort` | `string` | `Clear sort` |  |
| `sortedAscending` | `string` | `Sorted ascending` |  |
| `sortedDescending` | `string` | `Sorted descending` |  |
| `columnActions` | `string` | `Column actions` |  |
| `hideColumn` | `string` | `Hide column` |  |
| `showAllColumns` | `string` | `Show all columns` |  |
| `pinToLeft` | `string` | `Pin to left` |  |
| `pinToRight` | `string` | `Pin to right` |  |
| `unpin` | `string` | `Unpin` |  |
| `reorderColumn` | `string` | `Reorder column` |  |
| `reorderRow` | `string` | `Reorder row` |  |
| `pinRow` | `string` | `Pin row` |  |
| `unpinRow` | `string` | `Unpin row` |  |
| `resizeColumn` | `string` | `Resize column` |  |
| `groupByColumn` | `(column: string) => string` | `(column) => `Group by ${column}`` |  |
| `ungroupByColumn` | `(column: string) => string` | `(column) => `Ungroup by ${column}`` |  |
| `groupedBy` | `string` | `Grouped by` |  |
| `dropToGroupBy` | `string` | `Drag a column here to group by it` |  |
| `expand` | `string` | `Expand` |  |
| `collapse` | `string` | `Collapse` |  |
| `expandAll` | `string` | `Expand all` |  |
| `collapseAll` | `string` | `Collapse all` |  |
| `toggleRowExpanded` | `string` | `Toggle row expanded` |  |
| `columnVisibility` | `string` | `Column visibility` |  |
| `toggleColumnVisibility` | `string` | `Toggle column visibility` |  |
| `filterByColumn` | `(column: string) => string` | `(column) => `Filter by ${column}`` |  |
| `clearFilter` | `string` | `Clear filter` |  |
| `filterMode` | `string` | `Filter mode` |  |
| `changeFilterMode` | `string` | `Change filter mode` |  |
| `filterPlaceholder` | `(column: string) => string` | `(column) => `Filter ${column}…`` |  |
| `showColumnFilters` | `string` | `Show filters` |  |
| `hideColumnFilters` | `string` | `Hide filters` |  |
| `min` | `string` | `Min` |  |
| `max` | `string` | `Max` |  |
| `pickDate` | `string` | `Pick a date` |  |
| `pickDateRange` | `string` | `Pick a date range` |  |
| `true` | `string` | `True` |  |
| `false` | `string` | `False` |  |
| `filterModes` | `Record<string, string>` | `{     fuzzy: "Fuzzy",     contains: "Contains",     startsWith: "Starts with",     endsWith: "Ends with",     equals: "Equals",     notEquals: "Not equals",     empty: "Empty",     notEmpty: "Not empty",     between: "Between (exclusive)",     betweenInclusive: "Between (inclusive)",     greaterThan: "Greater than",     greaterThanOrEqualTo: "Greater than or equal to",     lessThan: "Less than",     lessThanOrEqualTo: "Less than or equal to",     before: "Before",     after: "After",     betweenDates: "Between",     equalsString: "Equals",     arrIncludesSome: "Includes",     equalsBool: "Equals",   }` | Labels for each filter mode, keyed by the `FilterMode` string. |
| `advancedFilters` | `string` | `Advanced filters` |  |
| `advancedFiltersMatch` | `(logic: string) => string` | `(logic) => `Match ${logic} of the following rules`` | The "Match All/Any of the following rules" sentence; `logic` marks where the All/Any picker goes, so each language can order the words. |
| `advancedFiltersMatchAll` | `string` | `All` |  |
| `advancedFiltersMatchAny` | `string` | `Any` |  |
| `advancedFiltersAddRule` | `string` | `Add filter` |  |
| `advancedFiltersApply` | `string` | `Apply` |  |
| `advancedFiltersClearAll` | `string` | `Clear all` |  |
| `advancedFiltersColumn` | `string` | `Column` |  |
| `advancedFiltersOperator` | `string` | `Operator` |  |
| `advancedFiltersValue` | `string` | `Value` |  |
| `advancedFiltersEmpty` | `string` | `No filters yet. Add one to get started.` |  |
| `removeFilterRule` | `string` | `Remove filter` |  |
| `advancedFilterOperators` | `Record<string, string>` | `{     contains: "contains",     notContains: "does not contain",     startsWith: "starts with",     endsWith: "ends with",     equals: "equals",     notEquals: "does not equal",     isEmpty: "is empty",     isNotEmpty: "is not empty",     greaterThan: "greater than",     greaterThanOrEqual: "greater than or equal",     lessThan: "less than",     lessThanOrEqual: "less than or equal",     between: "is between",   }` | Operator labels, keyed by `AdvancedFilterOperator`. |
| `search` | `string` | `Search` |  |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `string` | `Search…` |  |
| `clearSearch` | `string` | `Clear search` |  |
| `globalFilterMode` | `string` | `Search mode` |  |
| `toggleDensity` | `string` | `Toggle density` |  |
| `densityComfortable` | `string` | `Comfortable` |  |
| `densityCompact` | `string` | `Compact` |  |
| `densitySpacious` | `string` | `Spacious` |  |
| `enterFullscreen` | `string` | `Enter full screen` |  |
| `exitFullscreen` | `string` | `Exit full screen` |  |
| `rowsPerPage` | `string` | `Rows per page` |  |
| `paginationRange` | `(start: number, end: number, total: number) => string` | `(start, end, total) => `${start.toLocaleString("en")}–${end.toLocaleString("en")} of ${total.toLocaleString("en")}`` |  |
| `goToFirstPage` | `string` | `Go to first page` |  |
| `goToPreviousPage` | `string` | `Go to previous page` |  |
| `goToNextPage` | `string` | `Go to next page` |  |
| `goToLastPage` | `string` | `Go to last page` |  |
| `goToPage` | `(page: number) => string` | `(page) => `Go to page ${page.toLocaleString("en")}`` |  |
| `rowActions` | `string` | `Row actions` |  |
| `edit` | `string` | `Edit` |  |
| `save` | `string` | `Save` |  |
| `cancel` | `string` | `Cancel` |  |
| `delete` | `string` | `Delete` |  |
| `create` | `string` | `Create` |  |
| `createNewRow` | `string` | `Create new row` |  |
| `editRow` | `string` | `Edit row` |  |
| `required` | `string` | `Required` |  |
| `copy` | `string` | `Copy` |  |
| `copied` | `string` | `Copied` |  |
| `cellActions` | `string` | `Cell actions` |  |
| `noRecordsToDisplay` | `string` | `No records to display` |  |
| `noResultsFound` | `string` | `No results found` | Shown instead of `noRecordsToDisplay` when filters or the search hide every row. |
| `aggregationFns` | `Record<string, string>` |  | Labels for aggregation function names, shown when a column lists several (`aggregationFn: ["sum", "mean"]`). Merged with the English defaults by key; unknown names show as written. |
| `loading` | `string` | `Loading…` |  |
| `loadingMore` | `string` | `Loading more…` |  |
| `dragStart` | `(label: string) => string` | `(label) => `Picked up ${label}.`` |  |
| `dragOver` | `(label: string, over: string) => string` | `(label, over) => `${label} is over ${over}.`` |  |
| `dragEnd` | `(label: string, over: string) => string` | `(label, over) => `${label} was dropped on ${over}.`` |  |
| `dragCancel` | `(label: string) => string` | `(label) => `Dragging was cancelled. ${label} was dropped.`` |  |
| `dragInstructions` | `string` | `To pick up an item, press space or enter. While dragging, use the arrow keys to move it. Press space or enter again to drop it, or press escape to cancel.` |  |
| `dragRowLabel` | `(position: number) => string` | `(position) => `Row ${position.toLocaleString("en")}`` |  |

<!-- https://monabbir-ahmmad.github.io/shadcn-react-table/docs/api/icons/ -->

# Icons

Every glyph the table renders is a named slot. Override any subset via `useDataTable({ icons })` (or app-wide via [`DataTableConfigProvider`](/docs/guides/custom-icons)) to swap icon libraries or individual icons. Each value is an `IconComponent` — any component accepting a `className`.

```tsx
import { ArrowUp, ArrowDown, MoreVertical } from "lucide-react"

const table = useDataTable({
  data,
  columns,
  icons: {
    sortAscending: ArrowUp,
    sortDescending: ArrowDown,
    columnActions: MoreVertical,
  },
})
```

See the [Custom icons guide](/docs/guides/custom-icons) for swapping the whole set. The complete slot list and Remix Icon defaults:

| Slot | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sortAscending` | `IconComponent` | `ArrowUp` | Header sort indicator: sorted ascending. |
| `sortDescending` | `IconComponent` | `ArrowDown` | Header sort indicator: sorted descending. |
| `sortUnsorted` | `IconComponent` | `ChevronsUpDown` | Header sort indicator: sortable but not sorted. |
| `columnActions` | `IconComponent` | `MoreVertical` | Column-actions menu trigger in each header. |
| `filter` | `IconComponent` | `Filter` | Filter toggle and filter menu items. |
| `filterOff` | `IconComponent` | `FilterX` | Hide-filters state of the filter toggle and clear-filter items. |
| `advancedFilter` | `IconComponent` | `ListFilter` | Advanced filter panel toggle. |
| `clearAll` | `IconComponent` | `RotateCcw` | Clear-sort / show-all reset action. |
| `hide` | `IconComponent` | `EyeOff` | Hide-column menu item. |
| `pin` | `IconComponent` | `Pin` | Pin column and pin row actions. |
| `pinnedRow` | `IconComponent` | `Pin` | Shown on a pinned row's pin button. |
| `unpin` | `IconComponent` | `PinOff` | Unpin column and unpin row actions. |
| `group` | `IconComponent` | `Group` | Group-by menu item and grouping chips. |
| `columnVisibility` | `IconComponent` | `Columns3` | Column-visibility (show/hide columns) toolbar button. |
| `density` | `IconComponent` | `Rows3` | Density toggle toolbar button. |
| `fullscreenEnter` | `IconComponent` | `Maximize2` | Full-screen toggle while not full screen. |
| `fullscreenExit` | `IconComponent` | `Minimize2` | Full-screen toggle while full screen. |
| `search` | `IconComponent` | `Search` | Global search button and search-mode menu. |
| `clear` | `IconComponent` | `X` | Clear buttons (search box, filter inputs, grouping chips). |
| `pageFirst` | `IconComponent` | `ChevronsLeft` | Pagination: first page. Mirrored in right-to-left tables. |
| `pagePrev` | `IconComponent` | `ChevronLeft` | Pagination: previous page. Mirrored in right-to-left tables. |
| `pageNext` | `IconComponent` | `ChevronRight` | Pagination: next page. Mirrored in right-to-left tables. |
| `pageLast` | `IconComponent` | `ChevronsRight` | Pagination: last page. Mirrored in right-to-left tables. |
| `expanded` | `IconComponent` | `ChevronDown` | Expand control of an expanded row or group. |
| `collapsed` | `IconComponent` | `ChevronRight` | Expand control of a collapsed row or group. Mirrored in right-to-left tables. |
| `dragHandle` | `IconComponent` | `GripVertical` | Drag grip for column and row reordering. |
| `edit` | `IconComponent` | `Pencil` | Edit row / edit cell action. |
| `copy` | `IconComponent` | `Copy` | Copy action in the cell menu. |
| `save` | `IconComponent` | `Check` | Save action while editing a row. |
| `cancel` | `IconComponent` | `X` | Cancel action while editing a row. |
| `calendar` | `IconComponent` | `Calendar` | Date filter field trigger. |
